learning_objective: 🎯 Become a musical storyteller by learning how to write your own lyrics and pair them with fun, catchy rhythms!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Lyrics are simply the words of a song! A good song tells a story or shares a strong feeling. If you can write a short poem, you already know the secret to writing great lyrics.
Every song needs a topic or theme. You can write a song about anything: your favorite pet, a funny dream you had, or even how much you love eating pizza on Fridays!
The chorus is the most important part of the song because it repeats multiple times. It is usually the easiest part to remember, and it is the part everyone loves to sing along to!
Words that sound the same at the end are called rhymes, like 'cat' and 'hat' or 'star' and 'car'. Rhyming makes your lyrics flow nicely and sound like real music when spoken out loud.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 My Favorite Thing Song
fun_activity.instructions: Pick your favorite food or toy. Write four simple lines about it, making sure the last words of line 2 and line 4 rhyme. Now, try singing your new poem to the tune of 'Twinkle Twinkle Little Star'!

quick_recap: ⭐ Songwriting is the art of combining words (lyrics) with a melody.
⭐ You can choose any fun or serious theme to write your song about.
⭐ The chorus is the catchy part of the song that repeats over and over.
⭐ Using rhyming words helps your lyrics sound like a smooth, musical poem.
